## 2. Boundary Definitions & Contracts

### B1. Backend API & Edge Gateway (`server.ts` / `server/worker.ts`)
1. **Inside vs. Outside**
   - **Inside**: Request authentication (`tenantAuthMiddleware` in [server.ts](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L47-L79)), rate limiting (`limitTwilioNotifications` in [server.ts](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L108-L135)), Twilio E.164 validation & delivery ([`sendDispatchSms`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server/twilioMessaging.ts#L21-L74)), Gemini Google Search grounding ([`fetchRegionalWeatherHazards`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server/weatherHazards.ts#L278-L428)), and predictive/quantum compute endpoints.
   - **Outside**: Browser DOM state, `localStorage` persistence, Web Audio chimes, and git/tar shell operations ([`handleCloudflareDownload`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L833-L871) and [`handleCloudflarePush`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L875-L923), which belong in CI/CD scripts rather than the runtime API server).
2. **Boundary Contract**
   - **Auth Header**: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `x-api-key`, plus `x-tenant-id`.
   - **REST Endpoints**:
     - `POST /api/dispatch-messages` & `POST /api/dispatch-loop/alert` → `{ success: boolean, carrierSid?: string, carrierStatus?: string, messageId?: string }`
     - `POST /api/telematics/idle-alert` → `{ vehicleUnit, driverName, idleDurationMinutes (>=15), engineRpm, idleFuelWastedGallons, idleCostUsd, locationName }`
     - `GET|POST /api/weather/regional-hazards` → [`RegionalWeatherHazardResponse`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server/weatherHazards.ts#L28-L46)
     - `POST /api/memory/track`, `GET /api/memory/stats`, `POST /api/quantum/telemetry-physics`, `POST /api/quantum/hos-optimizer`
3. **Concrete Changes to Avoid Tight Coupling**
   - **Unify Express & Cloudflare Worker routes**: [server/worker.ts](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server/worker.ts#L123-L157) exposes `/api/weather/hazards`, whereas [server.ts](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L762-L798) and the frontend [`RegionalWeatherHazardService.refreshHazards`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/regionalWeatherHazardService.ts#L247) call `/api/weather/regional-hazards`. Align route paths and response schemas across both runtimes.
   - **Remove shell execution from Express**: Extract `/api/export-cloudflare-github/*` ([server.ts](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L804-L925)) out of the production API process into standalone CLI/deployment scripts.
4. **Shared Code to Keep Minimal & Stable**
   - DTO interfaces ([`RegionalWeatherHazardResponse`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server/weatherHazards.ts#L28-L46), [`MemorySnapshot`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L15-L27), [`QuantumPhysicsResponse`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/quantumPredictiveService.ts#L1-L13)) are currently duplicated between `server.ts`, `server/weatherHazards.ts`, and `src/services/*`. Move pure API contracts into a single shared `src/contracts/api.ts`.

1. **Inside vs. Outside**
   - **Inside**: Stop geofence state machine ([`createStopTracker`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/detention-proof/src/detentionEngine.js#L21-L141)), event validation ([`validateStop`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/detention-proof/src/validate.js#L4-L15), [`validateEvents`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/detention-proof/src/validate.js#L17-L31)), ELD feed normalization ([`createSamsaraMapper`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/detention-proof/src/adapters/samsara.js#L14-L40), [`mapMotiveLocation`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/detention-proof/src/adapters/motive.js#L7-L11)), cryptographic evidence sealing ([`buildEvidencePacket`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/detention-proof/src/evidence.js#L18-L62)), and Firestore/memory persistence ([`createPersistentService`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/detention-proof/src/persistent.js#L8-L43)).

2. **Boundary Contract**
   - **Normalized Telemetry Events**:
     - `{ type: 'gps', ts: number, lat: number, lng: number, speedMph?: number }`
     - `{ type: 'door', ts: number, state: 'open' | 'closed' }`
     - `{ type: 'call', ts: number, durationSec: number, direction?: string, number?: string }`
   - **HTTP API** ([detention-proof/src/server.js](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/detention-proof/src/server.js#L52-L96)):
     - `POST /v1/stops` (`{ vehicleId, stop, ctx }`)

3. **Concrete Changes to Avoid Tight Coupling**

4. **Shared Code to Keep Minimal & Stable**

### B3. J1939 ELD & Telematics Safety Engine
1. **Inside vs. Outside**
   - **Inside**: Web Bluetooth GATT / J1939 PGN/SPN decoding ([`BluetoothEldService`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/bluetoothEldService.ts#L137-L405)), G-force/harsh braking/collision black-box state ([`TelematicsTelemetryState`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/telematicsSafetyService.ts#L465-L518)), and state statutory truck speed limit lookup ([`StateGeolocationService`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/stateGeolocationService.ts#L47-L243)).
   - **Outside**: Web Audio synthesizer calls ([`playTelematicsSoundAlert`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/telematicsSafetyService.ts#L620-L715)) and independent `navigator.geolocation.watchPosition` loops in other services.
2. **Boundary Contract**
   - **Pub/Sub Stream**: `bluetoothEldService.subscribe((telemetry: J1939LiveTelemetry, status: BluetoothConnectionStatus) => void)`
   - **State Geolocation Stream**: `stateGeolocationService.subscribe((state: StateGeolocationState) => void)`
   - **FMCSA Duty Callback**: `bluetoothEldService.setFmcsaDutyTrigger((isMoving: boolean) => void)` (triggered at `wheelSpeedMph >= 5.0`).
3. **Concrete Changes to Avoid Tight Coupling**
   - **Eliminate duplicate GPS & speed loops**: Currently, [`App.tsx`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/App.tsx#L201-L212) runs its own `setInterval` speed jitter, [`BluetoothEldService`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/bluetoothEldService.ts#L330-L378) runs a 500ms speed/RPM loop, [`StateGeolocationService`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/stateGeolocationService.ts#L121-L150) opens a `navigator.geolocation.watchPosition` watcher, and [`RealtimeRouteWeatherService`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/realtimeRouteWeatherService.ts#L308-L342) opens a *second* `navigator.geolocation.watchPosition` watcher.
   - **Fix**: Make `StateGeolocationService` (or a single `VehiclePositionBus`) the sole owner of browser GPS coordinates, and `BluetoothEldService` the sole owner of vehicle speed/odometer, publishing updates to subscribers.
   - **Replace single-slot callback**: [`setFmcsaDutyTrigger`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/bluetoothEldService.ts#L238-L240) only allows one listener (`this.fmcsaAutoDutyTrigger = fn`), which silently overwrites previous subscribers if multiple components register. Replace it with a `Set` of listeners or derive `isMoving` directly from `subscribe()`.

A consistent, production-grade error-handling and structured logging architecture has been designed and implemented across both the frontend React cockpit and backend Express services.

---

### 1. Error Types, Codes, and Layer Responsibilities

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph UI ["3. Presentation / UI Layer (Cockpit HUD)"]
        EB["CockpitErrorBoundary"]
        TOAST["Tactical Toast & Alerts (#FFE500 / #EF4444)"]
        MODAL["Driver Auth & Roster Modals"]
    end

    subgraph Domain ["1. Domain Layer (Safety & Compliance Logic)"]
        RULES["Safety Rules & Invariants"]
        HRE["FHWA 54B Clearance Engine"]
        HOS["FMCSA § 395 HOS Rules"]
        MECH["Master Mechanic & Jackknife Sentinel"]
        DERR["Domain Errors (DomainValidationError, ClearanceViolationError, etc.)"]
    end

    subgraph Infra ["2. Infrastructure Layer (I/O, Network & Storage)"]
        API["Backend API & Express Routes"]
        STORAGE["Resilient Storage (safeStorage)"]
        CANBUS["J1939 CAN-Bus & Traxxas Telemetry"]
        NET["External Services (Twilio, Weather)"]
        IERR["Infrastructure Errors (StoragePersistenceError, NetworkError, etc.)"]
    end

    Domain -->|Throws Typed AppError| UI
    Infra -->|Translates Low-Level I/O to AppError| Domain
    Infra -->|Fallback Memory Cache| UI
    UI -->|Displays Driver-Safe Actionable Advice| Driver((Driver / Cockpit))
```

#### Layer Responsibilities ("Who Handles What")

| Layer | Responsibilities | Errors Raised | How It Handles Them |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Domain Layer** | Validates safety invariants, regulatory limits (49 CFR § 395/396, FHWA Item 54B), driver credentials, and load yield math. Independent of UI and transport protocols. | [`DomainValidationError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L125-L135), [`ClearanceViolationError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L137-L157), [`HosComplianceError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L159-L171), [`KingpinJackknifeError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L173-L184) | Throws typed domain errors with explicit error codes, severity levels (`CRITICAL`, `WARNING`), and sanitized driver-friendly messages. Does not swallow or silently fallback. |
| **Infrastructure Layer** | Handles external I/O: HTTP APIs, `localStorage`, J1939 CAN-Bus, Bluetooth ELD, Twilio SMS, and meteorological feeds. | [`StoragePersistenceError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L201-L213), [`NetworkError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L188-L199), [`CanBusCommunicationError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L215-L225) | Catches raw transport/disk exceptions (e.g. `QuotaExceededError`, `ECONNREFUSED`). Translates them into infrastructure errors, initiates resilient fallbacks (such as in-memory memory cache in [`safeStorage`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/safeStorage.ts)), and emits structured logs. |
| **UI / Presentation Layer** | Cockpit displays, Night HUD overlays, forms, and modals. | [`CockpitRenderError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L227-L238) | Catches render faults using [`CockpitErrorBoundary`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/components/CockpitErrorBoundary.tsx) to prevent "white screens of death". Translates error codes to high-visibility tactical HUD banners ([`Toast`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/components/Toast.tsx)) in High-Visibility Safety Yellow (`#FFE500`) and Chamfered Ruby Red (`#EF4444`). |

#### Error Code Taxonomy

All application errors inherit from [`AppError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L78-L125) and use standard codes:
- **Authentication & CDL**: `E_AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS`, `E_AUTH_PIN_MISMATCH`, `E_AUTH_CDL_REQUIRED`, `E_AUTH_CDL_EXPIRED`, `E_AUTH_DRIVER_NOT_FOUND`, `E_AUTH_VALIDATION_FAILED`
- **Low-Bridge & Route Hazards**: `E_CLEARANCE_CRITICAL_OVERPASS`, `E_CLEARANCE_ADVISORY`, `E_ROUTE_STEEP_GRADE`, `E_ROUTE_HAZMAT_RESTRICTION`
- **Master Mechanic & Telematics**: `E_CANBUS_TIMEOUT`, `E_CANBUS_DISCONNECTED`, `E_CANBUS_FRAME_CORRUPT`, `E_JACKKNIFE_THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED`, `E_DTC_FAULT_ACTIVE`
- **HOS Compliance**: `E_HOS_DRIVE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `E_HOS_DUTY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `E_HOS_REST_BREAK_REQUIRED`
- **Storage & Infrastructure**: `E_STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED`, `E_STORAGE_READ_FAILED`, `E_NET_UPSTREAM_FAILURE`, `E_NET_OFFLINE`
- **System**: `E_SYS_RENDER_CRASH`, `E_SYS_UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION`, `E_SYS_NOT_FOUND`

---

### 2. Where to Log and What to Include

Logging is centralized via [`logger`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/logger.ts), which writes structured JSON and maintains an in-memory ring buffer (last 250 records) for cockpit diagnostics and DOT vault exports.

#### Logging Level Matrix

| Level | When & Where to Use | Typical Subsystems | What to Include |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`debug`** | High-frequency telemetry polling, cache hits/misses, component state transitions. | `TRAXXAS_10HZ`, `CAN_BUS_POLL`, `SPEECH_RECOGNITION` | Cycle duration, transponder ping latency, sampling delta, memory footprint. |
| **`info`** | Key operational milestones and audit trails. | `AUTH_SERVICE`, `DISPATCH_ZERO`, `INSPECTION_AUDIT` | Active driver ID, dispatch ID, yield rate (`$/Hr`), PDF hash, 49 CFR § 395 attestation timestamp. |
| **`warn`** | Recoverable faults, offline cache fallbacks, advisory clearances (<6" delta), failed login attempts. | `HRE_ROUTING`, `STORAGE`, `WEATHER_API` | Error code, corridor, clearance buffer delta, fallback mode flag, masked credential identifier. |
| **`error`** | Critical system failures, unrecoverable disk drops, 0" clearance bridge alert, uncaught API exceptions. | `COCKPIT_UI`, `SERVER_EXPRESS`, `MASTER_MECHANIC` | Error code, correlation trace ID, HTTP status, sanitized component/API stack trace, affected vehicle unit. |

#### Structured Log Schema
```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-10-31T17:23:34.787Z",
  "level": "warn",
  "subsystem": "AUTH_SERVICE",
  "message": "Driver sign-in credential rejection: Authentication rejected: Invalid FMCSA Roadside PIN credentials.",
  "code": "E_AUTH_PIN_MISMATCH",
  "correlationId": "req-mvwo6xvn-rez6",
  "metadata": {
    "identifier": "IL****20",
    "pin": "[REDACTED]"
  },
  "error": {
    "name": "DomainValidationError",
    "message": "Authentication rejected: Invalid FMCSA Roadside PIN credentials.",
    "code": "E_AUTH_PIN_MISMATCH",
    "category": "DOMAIN",
    "severity": "WARNING"
  }
}
```

#### Sensitive Data Redaction
Data sanitization is enforced by [`sanitizeMetadata`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L292-L318) before any metadata is emitted:
- **Total Redaction (`[REDACTED]`)**: FMCSA Roadside PINs (`pin`, `fmcsaPin`), account passwords, bearer tokens, API secrets, authorization headers, SSNs.
- **Masking (`IL****20`)**: CDL license numbers and identifiers retain the issuing state prefix and trailing digits, masking all internal digits.
- **Phone Masking (`***-***-5678`)**: Retains only the last 4 digits.

---

### 3. Replacing Ad-Hoc Try/Catch and Silent Failures

Key ad-hoc try/catch blocks and silent failure patterns were replaced:

1. **Driver Registration & Sign-In Silent Fallbacks Removed**:
   - In [`authDriverService.ts`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/authDriverService.ts#L125-L210), invalid client inputs or HTTP 400 server validation errors previously triggered a `catch` block that silently generated a synthetic driver and returned `{ success: true }`.
   - **Resolution**: Explicit domain validations for driver name and CDL number now throw [`DomainValidationError`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L125-L135). Remote validation rejections bubble up to the UI modal and toast. Offline registration is restricted to true network disconnects.
2. **Resilient LocalStorage Persistence**:
   - Replaced bare `try { localStorage.setItem(...) } catch (e) { console.error(...) }` across [`fuelLogService.ts`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/fuelLogService.ts#L60-L80) and driver caching with [`safeStorage`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/safeStorage.ts).
   - Handles quota limits or private browsing restrictions with an automatic volatile in-memory fallback, structured telemetry logging, and typed `StorageResult<T>` returns.
3. **Cockpit Crash Isolation (`CockpitErrorBoundary`)**:
   - Integrated [`CockpitErrorBoundary`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/components/CockpitErrorBoundary.tsx) inside [`App.tsx`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/App.tsx#L420-L430).
   - If any screen throws an unhandled rendering error, the cockpit surface renders a tactical recovery panel (`#05080E` obsidian background, `#EF4444` chamfered alert, and `#FFE500` yellow recovery button: `>> REINITIALIZE COCKPIT SUBSYSTEM`), keeping core CAN-Bus and telemetry processes active.
4. **Backend Express Correlation & Central Error Handler**:
   - In [`server.ts`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L47-L80) and [lines 1150–1195](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/server.ts#L1150-L1195), added correlation ID generation (`X-Correlation-Id`), structured API access logging, and a centralized Express error middleware that catches uncaught exceptions and formats standard `{ success: false, error: { code, message, correlationId } }` responses.

### 4. End-to-End Example: Error Raised → Logged → Surfaced to User

The end-to-end lifecycle is demonstrated during **Driver Roadside PIN Sign-In**:

#### Step 1: Error Raised (Domain / Service Layer)
The driver attempts sign-in with an incorrect FMCSA PIN in [`authDriverService.signin()`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/services/authDriverService.ts#L225-L270):
```ts
if (payload.fmcsaPin && match.fmcsaPin !== payload.fmcsaPin) {
  const pinError = new DomainValidationError(
    'FMCSA Roadside PIN mismatch for driver profile.',
    {
      identifier: payload.identifier, // e.g. "IL-CDL-98104820"
      pin: payload.fmcsaPin,          // e.g. "0000"
    },
    'E_AUTH_PIN_MISMATCH'
  );
  throw pinError;
}
```

#### Step 2: Error Logged (Structured Logger)
The service catches the failure, scrubs sensitive credentials via [`sanitizeMetadata`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/errors.ts#L292-L318), and logs via [`logger`](https://github.com/jeremiahjmorris1126-coder/TRUCKWITHEASE-1/blob/main/src/utils/logger.ts):
```ts
logger.warn('AUTH_SERVICE', `Driver sign-in credential rejection: ${pinError.userMessage}`, pinError.details, pinError);
```
